items.quote: Pluggables gets you pretty much all the way there.
items.speaker: Timothy Breen (CEO)

items.claim: Notes former copper proponents have entered optical, so participants in optical have broadened.
items.quote: everyone who was touting copper 2 years ago
items.speaker: Timothy Breen (CEO)

items.claim: GaN products already shipping to data center; BCD 55nm in new conversion stages.
items.quote: We're shipping GaN products to the data center today.
items.speaker: Timothy Breen (CEO)

items.claim: Power/BCD pull-through to business not yet seen; expected in 2027 and more in 2028, with capacity added then.
items.quote: We have yet to see the real pull-through for the business
items.speaker: Timothy Breen (CEO)

items.claim: Mobile share of revenue defined: from >50% to mid-30s, long-term model mid-20s.
items.quote: that's down to the mid-30s today
items.speaker: Timothy Breen (CEO)

items.claim: Medium-term plan does not depend on mobile growth.
items.quote: we do not rely on it growing to achieve our medium-term plan
items.speaker: Timothy Breen (CEO)

items.claim: Describes mobile as a tough year, especially at the low end; GF more exposed to higher-end handsets.
items.quote: It is indeed a tough year.
items.speaker: Timothy Breen (CEO)

items.claim: Mobile customers are asking to secure 2027 and 2028 supply even if units are down low double digits.
items.quote: I need my supply for '27, I need my supply for '28
items.speaker: Timothy Breen (CEO)

items.claim: Automotive share of revenue went from 2% five years ago to the 20s today.
items.quote: We were, sort of 5 years ago, 2%. It's now in the 20s.
items.speaker: Timothy Breen (CEO)

items.claim: Auto double-digit growth expected to continue this year, next year and beyond, driven by content not units.
items.quote: will continue this year, next year and beyond
items.speaker: Timothy Breen (CEO)

items.claim: GM cited as having secured capacity itself with GF as part of NCNT/US-for-US sourcing push in auto.
items.quote: securing that capacity themselves as GM did with us
items.speaker: Timothy Breen (CEO)

items.claim: Reshoring: NCNT now the rule in procurement, whereas footprint was previously not a differentiator.
items.quote: NCNT is the rule, not a nice-to-have, right?
items.speaker: Timothy Breen (CEO)

items.claim: Physical AI described as early stage, not yet materially hitting the business.
items.quote: We haven't seen that really materially hit the business yet.
items.speaker: Timothy Breen (CEO)

items.claim: About six acquisitions in two years; IP acquisitions (MIPS, RISC-V, Synopsys ARC) framed by customer reaction test.
items.quote: We've done about 6 acquisitions in the last 2 years.
items.speaker: Timothy Breen (CEO)

items.claim: IP/software/custom silicon revenue stated at $100–120M this year with $1B exit run-rate target by end of decade.
items.quote: between $100 million and $120 million of revenue this year
items.speaker: Timothy Breen (CEO)

items.claim: Expresses confidence in the $1B end-of-decade IP run-rate.
items.quote: very confident for that end of decade kind of $1 billion
items.speaker: Timothy Breen (CEO)

items.claim: Describes IP acquisitions as accretive revenue with very good margins.
items.quote: accretive revenue, very good margins, very good growth
items.speaker: Timothy Breen (CEO)

items.claim: Claims position as second-largest processor IP supplier after the incumbent.
items.quote: probably the second largest processor IP supplier
items.speaker: Timothy Breen (CEO)

items.claim: Synopsys ARC acquisition brought a 300-customer base GF is now engaging.
items.quote: it came with 300 customers
items.speaker: Timothy Breen (CEO)

items.claim: Names Lockheed Martin (defense) as an IP-related engagement.
items.quote: we had an announcement with Lockheed Martin about that
items.speaker: Timothy Breen (CEO)

items.claim: Quantum: bottleneck framed as high-volume manufacturing.
items.quote: the bottleneck is not quantum science, it's high-volume manufacturing
items.speaker: Timothy Breen (CEO)

items.claim: US government quantum deal completed; accelerates investment in tooling and infrastructure.
items.quote: we completed the deal that we announced earlier in the year
items.speaker: Timothy Breen (CEO)

items.claim: Comm infrastructure/data center end-market running 60% in Q2 vs long-term target in the 30s; auto in line, IoT slightly ahead.
items.quote: We're doing 60% in Q2.
items.speaker: Timothy Breen (CEO)

items.claim: Says no demand constraint to meeting and exceeding the long-term plan.
items.quote: I don't see a demand constraint to meeting and exceeding
items.speaker: Timothy Breen (CEO)

items.claim: Next couple of years described as supply-constrained rather than demand-constrained, barring environment changes.
items.quote: supply-constrained, not demand-constrained
items.speaker: Timothy Breen (CEO)

items.claim: Government partnerships provide capex acceleration tools with significant recovery rates.
items.quote: accelerate CapEx at significant recovery rates
items.speaker: Timothy Breen (CEO)

items.claim: Says diversification gives confidence; long-term plan numbers may look conservative.
items.quote: may even make those numbers look a bit conservative
items.speaker: Timothy Breen (CEO)

qa_flags.question: Harlan Sur 問年底毛利率是否可接近 33–35%
qa_flags.response_pattern: 未回應該區間，改談年增表現、營收增量對應毛利增量，並重申年底 30% 以上目標

qa_flags.question: Vivek Arya 問 CID 成長相對同業 50–100% 是否在流失份額
qa_flags.response_pattern: 未給份額數字，以三大子市場分述並稱未見流失

qa_flags.question: Vivek Arya 問年初與現在的定價假設及每片營收持續下滑
qa_flags.response_pattern: 未給定價數字，改談混合與毛利貢獻，稱以毛利結構為重

qa_flags.question: Krish Sankar 問 SCALE 與 TSMC COUPE／Tower 的比較與製程節點
qa_flags.response_pattern: 未給節點或規格比較，延後至 Investor Day

qa_flags.question: Ross Seymore 問 2Q 各終端市場與子類別方向性指引
qa_flags.response_pattern: 僅給年增方向與 IoT 回補，未給各市場 Q2 數字

qa_flags.question: Ross Seymore 問智慧行動裝置相對大盤的長期差距
qa_flags.response_pattern: 未回答，延後至 Investor Day，僅談新形態裝置的順風

qa_flags.question: Bryson：競爭對手稱握有逾 80% 矽光子市佔、營收與 GF 相近，如何解釋落差
qa_flags.response_pattern: Hogan 回「You can talk to the Tower about what they think」，未回應落差，改談自身十年投資與三大支柱

qa_flags.question: Garrigan：目前與 3 至 5 年後的市佔為何
qa_flags.response_pattern: 未給市佔百分比，只講自身為第一、SAM 約 10 億美元、預期市佔續升

qa_flags.question: Hosseini：光學以外先進封裝機會與 TAM 數字
qa_flags.response_pattern: Bartlett 與 Hogan 皆明說暫不給 TAM，改談產品組合與「stay tuned」

qa_flags.question: Ted Kang（Craig Group）請按事業別拆分 2030 毛利率，並問何以營業利益率槓桿不如毛利率
qa_flags.response_pattern: 管理層明確不拆毛利率（理由為產線設備可互換），改以組合與成本層次回覆；營業利益率差距以技術服務 R&D 密集解釋。

qa_flags.question: Charles Shi（Needham）請拆分毛利率改善中組合與效率占比，以及基礎晶圓代工毛利目標與補貼貢獻
qa_flags.response_pattern: CFO 給組合 5 至 6 點、成本 1 至 2 點等區間，但未提供基礎晶圓代工的毛利目標，也未量化補貼對毛利的貢獻。

qa_flags.question: Matt Bryson（Wedbush）問 1 百萬量子位元系統的含量或 TAM，及 IonQ 收購 SkyWater 的影響
qa_flags.response_pattern: Gregg 未給含量或 TAM 數字，改說之後有網路研討會，對 IonQ 事件僅說不評論；Tim 補充當日市場在找數字。
